info.title: emuiibo
info.author: XorTroll
info.details:
Virtual amiibo emulation.

Virtual amiibos are stored under `sd:/emuiibo/amiibo` and must be organized into subdirectories. 

Use the overlay to enable or disable amiibo emulation, select an active virtual amiibo, connect or disconnect it, and configure options such as randomized UUIDs.
